metadata.description: Useful live views and autoplaying pixel games for Claude Code.

plugins.name: change-journal
plugins.description: A live HTML page that shows every change Claude makes, with diffs, the reason for each edit, checks, and before/after behavior flows.

plugins.name: decision-lens
plugins.description: See the decisions Claude made in each turn, why it made them, and steer future turns with keep and avoid rules.

plugins.name: grill
plugins.description: While Claude works on your task, a sharp partner asks the questions that change the result. Answers reach Claude mid-turn. Brainstorm and side chat modes too.

plugins.name: samurai-dojo
plugins.description: A Claude samurai cuts down a Codex or Gemini alien for every tool call Claude makes.

plugins.name: slayer-corps
plugins.description: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu, and Inosuke fight their way to Muzan as you and Claude work. The story continues every session.

plugins.name: night-feast
plugins.description: A vampire feeds on every tool call Claude finishes while the moon tracks how full the context window is. Dawn means it is time to compact.

plugins.name: little-harvest
plugins.description: Every file that changes becomes a crop: Claude's edits and yours grow a farm above the prompt, tests bring sun or storms, and passing turns fill the barn.

plugins.name: pocket-familiar
plugins.description: A fox spirit that lives on your work: passing tests feed it, finished turns cheer it, and it grows up to nine tails.
